info.title: Payment Collection API
info.description: API for managing collection service related operations. It supports operations such as uploading a new document, retrieving the content or metadata of an existing document, and obtaining the status or history of statuses for a document.

post.description: API for uploading a single document as a file to the Collection Service system.

parameters.name: x-idempotency-key
parameters.description: Unique request identifier used as a idempotency key.

NotificationStatuses.description: Document statuses that the user will be notified about.

Content.description: The document to be uploaded. Ensure the file transfer follows the specifications outlined in `RFC 7578`, which defines file transfers using the `multipart/form-data` protocol.

ContentType.description: The standard MIME type and character set describing the format of the uploaded document.

ContentLength.description: The size of the uploaded document in bytes.

ContentMD5.description: The hexadecimal-encoded 128-bit MD5 digest of the uploaded document. This is used as a message integrity check to verify that the data received is the same as the data originally sent.
